msContents.summary: A paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya.

supportDesc.foliation: Devanāgarī numerals, top-left and bottom-right margin, verso.

lg.l: kasahasrasyaviprasya varadakṣiṇā ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparā ||
tasya dehād iyuktena na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit ||
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi ||
durllabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtadayāparaḥ ||
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ ||
na bhūtābhayadānasya kṣayam eva na vidyate ||
dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthasevā tathā chrutaṃ ||

sarvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍa
śīṃ ||
catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imāṃ ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyos tayor abhayado dhikaḥ ||

api tyajed rājyam idaṃ śarī
raṃ cāpi dustyajāaṃ ||
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyajec cainaṃ kapotakaṃ ||
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃścit tena janmani janmani ||

bhaveyam aham ā
rttānāṃ prāṇinām ārttināśanaḥ ||
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na svargaṃ na punarbhavaṃ ||
prāṇināṃ duḥkhamagnānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanaṃ ||
yathaiṣā nānṛtā tubhyam anyam eva dadāmy ahaṃ ||
ya eva vihito smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣyaḥ kapotakaḥ ||

tam evotsṛjya
nāhārai kārma manyain nareśvaraḥ ||
śyenāḥ pokakapotān khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī ||
mā rājāan_ sāram ajñātvā kadalīskaṃbham āruha ||
|| nanv ehaṃ śāstramārgeṇa sadā vartte vihaṃgamaḥ ||
śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmaḥ satyadayāparaḥ ||

sarvasatveṣu ya dānaṃm ekaṃ
satveṣu yā dayā ||
sarvasatvapradānāṃ dayaivākā viśiṣyate ||
sarve vedā na tat kuryu sarve yajñāś ca khecarā ||

sarvatīrthābhiṣekaś ca yaḥ ku
ryāt prāṇināṃ dayā ||
vāṅmanaḥkarmabhir ye tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
dayādarśitapaṃthāno vrahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te ||

gacchataḥ tiṣṭato vāpi
jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā ||
yan na bhūtahitārthāya tat paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ ||
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ ||

ātmavat parirakṣaṃ
ti te yāṃti te paramāṃ gatiṃ ||
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ sutu yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate ||
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur manīṣiṇāḥ ||

āhārarā
śiṃ sumahat prayachāmi tava dvijaḥ ||
yad vā kāmayase hy anyad varjjayitvā kapotakaṃ ||

|| yadi rājan kapoto te sudṛḍhā
prītir īdṛśī ||
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacha me ||
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase ||
etat te saṃprayachāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad ichasi ||
yad apriyaṃ tat sujanaś cirād vadati vā na vā |

mama tu priyam evaihata kasmād abhihitaṃ cirā
t ||
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā ||
dhruvaṃ yo nārjayed dharmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetasaḥ ||

yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yaṃ nopayu
jyate ||
tataḥ kim aparārodhyaḥ pratyahaṃ kṛyate vṛthā ||
nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ janeśvaraḥ ||

tasmāt kapote
na dhṛtaṃ prayacha tulayā dhṛtaṃ ||
tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yat me śyenābhibhāṣase ||

śyenasya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt tava cāpi
vihaṃgama ||
|| evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ ||
prahṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena samaṃ prabhuḥ ||
tyaktvāsmatsukhabhogechāṃ sarvasatvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ ||
bhavaṃti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitā ||

dhriyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vya
tiricyate ||
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ ||
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit ||

tataḥ prachidya so ṃgāni ā
ruroha tulāṃ svayaṃ ||
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
nāpekṣaṃte mahātmānaḥ svaduḥkhāni mahāṃty api ||

atha tasmin samā
rūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe ||
devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha ||
tatas tasya tadā matvā dharme rājño dhṛtiṃ parāam ||

śakraḥ svarūpa
m āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata ||
|| iṃdro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāhanaḥ ||

jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājann imaṃ ya
jñam upāgatau ||
naitat pūrve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃti cāpare ||
mahākāruṇiko neha yat kṛtaṃ duḥkṛtaṃ nṛpaṃ ||

parārthe tyajataḥ prāṇān yā prī
tir abhavat tava ||
prāṇasaṃśayaludhveṣu na sā prāṇeṣu dehināṃ ||
parārthekāṃtakalyāṇī svaśreyātyaṃtaniṣṭurā ||

tvayaiva kevalaṃ rājan ka
ruṇā karuṇāyate ||
svakarmapāśai sudṛḍhair vaddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat ||
tvaṃ jagadukhamokṣārthāṃ vaddhaḥ karuṇāyā nṛpa ||

tathā sarvātmanā
dharma doṣe hy apahṛtaṃ || tvayā ||
yathā caivātmasaṃsthāne vāsanāpi na vidyate ||
akṛtverṣyāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu na hīnānavamanya ca ||

aga
tvā sadṛśaiḥ sparddhā tvaṃ hy ekottamatāṃ gataḥ ||
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān yo naraḥ parirakṣati ||
sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma yato nāvartate punaḥ ||
prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ ||
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā ||

paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti kevalāśro
daraṃbharāḥ ||
sa punar jīvati ślāghyo yaḥ parārthe sa jīvati ||
kim atra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ ||

na hi svadehaśītāya jāyaṃte
caṃdanadrumāḥ ||
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā ||
sa padaṃ paramāpnoti parād avi hi yat paraṃ ||

paropakāraikadhiyaḥ svasukhāya
gataspṛhāḥ ||
jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi ||
matsvamāṃsāni bhutebhyaḥ samutkṛtyārpitāni ca ||

eṣā te śāśvatī kī
rtti lokān anugāmiṣyati ||
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā ciraṃ mahīṃ ||
sarvalokān atikramya vrahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi ||
|| evam uktvā taṃm iṃdrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayaṃ ||
rājā sa kratum iṣṭvā tu mumude devavac ciraṃ ||

ya idaṃ śṛṇuyāṃ nityaṃ śive
ś caritam uttamaṃ ||
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ tataḥ ||
viciṃtya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ || dhruvaṃ yaśaḥ sarvajanasya durlabhaṃ ||
śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇe yayau ||
